title: A Case Against Implicit Standards: Homophone Normalization in Machine Translation for Languages that use the Ge’ez Script
reasoning: The paper focuses on the linguistic and technical impacts of homophone normalization in Machine Translation for Ge’ez script languages. While it utilizes religious texts (the Bible) as part of its dataset and qualitatively examines the translation of religious terms (e.g., 'God'), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or ethics as its primary component.
